name: Global L10N Master 9-Gate & Profile Audit
note: This validator once required the false privacy claim: the shared spec pinned the lie in place rather than catching it. It also spent a long time requiring screens.stats.tabs.stats and .achievements — the names the stats screen carried before it was rewritten — which is the only reason those two keys survived in thirteen languages. A profile can be as stale as the code it checks, so it gets mutated like anything else.

mutations.name: a language loses a key the others have
mutations.why: The key falls back to its raw identifier, so one locale shows `modals.dailyReward.desc` where the others show a sentence.

mutations.name: the first stats tab label goes missing
mutations.why: The profile's required-key check was pointed at a dead key for so long that nothing noticed. Repointing it at achievements.statsTab is worthless unless the check actually fires when the key is gone.

mutations.name: a stats tab label grows past the segmented button
mutations.why: The length rule read a key with no fallback, so `typeof statTab === 'string'` was false and fourteen characters had not been enforced in a long time. Three tabs share one row; a long label pushes the other two off it. The first attempt used a 13-character string against a limit of 14, so it passed and was right to.

mutations.name: the leaderboard tab label grows past the segmented button
mutations.why: The third tab of a check named "Stats 3-Tab" had its value computed into ldrTab and then never used. It had no length limit at all.
